items.text: Nvidia partnered with Cloverleaf to develop data centers designed for large-scale AI computing workloads.
items.text_zh: 英伟达与 Cloverleaf 达成合作，将共同开发面向大规模人工智能计算的数据中心。

items.text: More than one million LinkedIn users have clicked the platform’s button for reporting low-quality AI-generated posts.
items.text_zh: 已有超过一百万名领英用户点击平台按钮，举报低质量的人工智能生成内容。

items.text: Ollama added Kimi K3 to the included usage available with all Pro and Max subscriptions.
items.text_zh: Ollama 已将 Kimi K3 纳入所有专业版和旗舰版订阅的自带用量。

items.text: GitHub discounted Copilot’s automatic model selection by 30% for Max subscribers through September 30, 2026.
items.text_zh: GitHub 将 Copilot 自动模型选择功能面向旗舰版订阅者降价三成，优惠持续至 2026 年 9 月 30 日。

items.text: OpenAI’s dashboards can now attribute API usage and spending to individual keys and enforce monthly organization or project budgets.
items.text_zh: OpenAI 的控制面板现可按单个密钥追踪接口用量与支出，并设置组织或项目月度预算。

items.text: HeyGen introduced Look Packs, which change a video subject’s outfit and setting while preserving facial identity.
items.text_zh: HeyGen 推出“造型包”，可在保持人物面部身份一致的同时，更换服装和场景。

items.text: Milvus 3.0 added regular-expression filters for safely scanning and matching text across millions of vector-database rows.
items.text_zh: Milvus 3.0 新增正则表达式过滤器，可在数百万行向量数据库记录中安全扫描和匹配文本。

items.text: Pika detailed Pika Speech, a three-billion-parameter text-to-speech model that generates one minute of audio in about 1.2 seconds during local tests.
items.text_zh: Pika 详解了三十亿参数的语音合成模型 Pika Speech；本地测试中，它约用 1.2 秒即可生成一分钟音频。

items.text: AWS published a four-stage architecture for governing agent tool access through centralized authentication, policies, auditing and private connectivity.
items.text_zh: 亚马逊云科技发布四阶段架构，通过集中认证、策略、审计和私有连接治理智能体的工具访问。

items.text: Google Research introduced an AI tool that prioritizes candidate biomarkers from wearable-sensor data for further clinical investigation.
items.text_zh: 谷歌研究院推出一款人工智能工具，可从可穿戴传感器数据中筛选值得进一步临床研究的候选生物标志物。

items.text: Microsoft released MAI-Image-2.6 for iterative image editing while maintaining consistency across changes to color, style and visual details.
items.text_zh: 微软发布 MAI-Image-2.6，可在迭代修改颜色、风格和视觉细节时保持图像一致性。

items.text: Vercel’s v0 can now connect applications and agents to Slack, GitHub, Salesforce and over 100 other services with managed authentication.
items.text_zh: Vercel 的 v0 现可通过托管身份认证，将应用和智能体连接到 Slack、GitHub、Salesforce 等一百多项服务。

items.text: Artificial Analysis launched MLCR-AA, a leaderboard testing models on difficult long-context reasoning tasks involving complex medical case files.
items.text_zh: Artificial Analysis 推出 MLCR-AA 排行榜，测试模型处理复杂医疗病例档案时的高难度长上下文推理能力。

items.text: Tripo’s METATAILOR Bridge left beta, enabling creators to transfer generated 3D models directly from Tripo Studio into METATAILOR.
items.text_zh: Tripo 的 METATAILOR Bridge 结束测试，创作者现可将生成的三维模型从 Tripo Studio 直接传入 METATAILOR。

items.text: JetBrains outlined its first measures for controlling rapidly growing AI-service costs while preserving access to AI-assisted development tools.
items.text_zh: JetBrains 公布首批 AI 服务成本控制措施，同时继续保障用户使用 AI 辅助开发工具。

items.text: Researchers found that world models poorly predict human actions when they omit people’s beliefs and perspectives.
items.text_zh: 研究发现，如果世界模型忽略人的信念与视角，其对人类行为的预测会明显失准。

items.text: Silicon Feather discussed using aerial robots with embodied AI to undertake inspections and other dangerous fieldwork.
items.text_zh: 硅羽科技介绍了利用具身智能飞行机器人执行巡检等危险现场作业的方案。

items.text: Galaxea AI and industry partners discussed moving embodied-intelligence systems from model development into productive commercial deployments.
items.text_zh: 星海图与产业合作伙伴探讨了如何推动具身智能从模型研发走向具备生产力的商业部署。

items.text: Latent Space examined why cheaper, faster simulations are increasingly replacing expensive real-world data collection for AI development.
items.text_zh: Latent Space 分析了更便宜、更快速的模拟为何正逐渐替代昂贵的真实世界数据采集。

items.text: Latent Space traced agent harnesses evolving from simple prompting layers into systems managing tools, context, memory and execution.
items.text_zh: Latent Space 梳理了智能体运行框架如何从简单提示层，演变为管理工具、上下文、记忆和执行的系统。

items.text: Netflix is testing a language model as an alternative to manually engineered logic in its recommendation system.
items.text_zh: Netflix 正测试用语言模型替代推荐系统中人工编写的部分规则逻辑。

items.text: Research applying psychological methods found substantial blind spots in common approaches for evaluating AI security.
items.text_zh: 一项采用心理学方法的研究发现，常见 AI 安全评估方式存在显著盲区。

items.text: Arena shared initial tests comparing Qwen3.8-27B with models up to roughly 100 times larger, including DeepSeek V4 and Kimi K3.
items.text_zh: Arena 分享了 Qwen3.8-27B 的初步测试，并将其与 DeepSeek V4、Kimi K3 等大至约百倍的模型比较。

items.text: VS Code demonstrated using GitHub Copilot to generate debugging configurations instead of manually recalling launch.json syntax.
items.text_zh: VS Code 演示了如何利用 GitHub Copilot 生成调试配置，免去手动记忆 launch.json 语法。

items.text: TechCrunch reported that Anthropic’s Opus 4.6 readily produces explicit sexual content despite the company’s stated safety positioning.
items.text_zh: TechCrunch 报道称，尽管 Anthropic 强调安全定位，Opus 4.6 仍能轻易生成露骨色情内容。

items.text: Replit introduced Conversations, allowing users to begin an application project through exploratory chat before entering the building workflow.
items.text_zh: Replit 推出 Conversations，让用户先通过探索式对话梳理应用构想，再进入正式构建流程。

items.text: Replit added beta Routines for scheduling recurring agent tasks and returning their results within the originating conversation.
items.text_zh: Replit 推出测试版 Routines，可定时运行智能体任务，并在原始对话中返回结果。

items.text: Replit added black-box penetration testing that examines deployed applications from an external attacker’s perspective.
items.text_zh: Replit 新增黑盒渗透测试功能，可从外部攻击者视角检查已部署的应用。
